objective: sum over candidate tables of unhappiness[table] * x[table], unhappiness = rank[last guest] - rank[first guest]

rank.description: Position on the guest list; tables spanning a wide rank range are unhappy Structural: the guest list order that defines table unhappiness; change the guest list (add/remove guests) rather than ranks.
rank.label: rank on the guest list

max_table_size.description: Maximum guests per table; candidate tables are all guest subsets of size 1..max_table_size Scenarios keep this at most 6: every candidate table is enumerated as a column, so larger tables blow up the model.
max_table_size.label: maximum guests per table

decision_variables.x[table]: binary, 1 if the candidate table is used

constraints.seat[guest]: sum over tables containing the guest of x[t] = 1
